system_definition: Two neutral isolated molecular models are required: 8OBAF acid and its 1:1 noncovalent complex with 4-cyanopyridine.

complex.interaction_constraint: Orient the 8OBAF carboxylic-acid hydroxyl H toward the pyridine ring N as an O-H...N hydrogen-bonded pair; do not create a covalent bond or change either component's connectivity.

model_boundary: gas-phase isolated molecules/complex; no solvent, periodic cell, dielectric continuum or bulk alignment is part of the required observable
observable: magnitude of the total molecular dipole moment in Debye
source_basis: The supplied molecular identities define the computational system; no paper lookup is needed to establish connectivity.
